# El Paso Electric

> El Paso Electric (EPE) is a utility provider serving West Texas and Southern New Mexico with electricity service, customer programs, and regulatory compliance.

El Paso Electric has been serving the region since 1901, operating across West Texas and Southern New Mexico including El Paso, Las Cruces, and surrounding areas. The company provides comprehensive customer service, outage management, energy efficiency programs, and maintains regulatory filings with the New Mexico Public Regulation Commission and Texas Public Utility Commission.
